intended_object: An affine open of a scheme X: an open subset U of X such that the open subscheme (U, O_X|_U) is an affine scheme, i.e. isomorphic to Spec R for some ring R. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The open `U : X.Opens` is coerced to the open subscheme `↑U` (X restricted to U). `IsAffine` says the canonical morphism to `Spec Γ(U)` is an isomorphism, which is equivalent to being isomorphic to the spectrum of some ring. So `IsAffine U` says exactly that the open subscheme is affine, which is the standard definition of an affine open. It holds for an arbitrary scheme X, so it is at full generality. The empty open counts as affine, since it is Spec 0, and that matches the standard convention. This is Mathlib's own definition of the notion, so there is no separate Mathlib counterpart.
